reviews.title: Gambling & Casino Ads
reviews.text:
First of all, let me get this straight. The app used to be AMAZING before all the ads. But right now 7 times out of 10 i am more likely to get an ad that wants you to download their GAMBLING app that claims to give you real money.

I think this is unacceptable, as gambling is strictly prohibited in Islam. 
Please fix your app. Advertising HARAM acts on an ISLAMIC app is purely disgusting.

reviews.title: Inappropriate Ads in a Prayer App
reviews.text:
You have introduced ads and a paid model, but the ads shown in your prayer app are unacceptable and do not align with Islamic values.

Not everyone can afford to pay, and free users should not be forced to watch inappropriate ads just so you can make money. Please fix your ad policy immediately.

reviews.title: Please fix errors in hadith and ayah wording
reviews.text: Assalamu alaikum. I like the idea of this app, but I noticed a serious issue with the daily hadith and daily verse. The wording is mixed up and not translated properly, and in some places it changes the meaning. These are not small mistakes as accuracy is very important when it comes to Qur’an and hadith. Please review and fix these errors as soon as possible. Jazka'Allahu Khair.
